annotations.title: utilpeek: make a 1-D barcode image (SVG or PNG)

description: utilpeek: make a 1-D barcode image. For QR codes use make_qr_code; to find the product behind a number use lookup_barcode_product. Returns `svg` (text, with width_mm/height_mm) or `data_base64` (PNG, with width_px/height_px; `output` "url": a 24 h link), plus `encoded` and `bytes`. A supplied check digit (ean13, ean8, upca, isbn13) must be right: a wrong one is a 422 invalid_checksum (not charged) rather than silently encoding a different number. Every output is decoded again with an independent reader (ZXing-C++): the answer carries `verified: true` and `decoded_text`, and a symbol that does not decode to the requested value is a 500 verify_failed (not charged). Encoded locally; typically under 0.1 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/barcode-generator-api.html
